input: Set up a standing desk treadmill trial at work

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Standing Desk Treadmill Trial at Work
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to arrange a trial period using a treadmill desk setup in their workplace environment.

questions.title: Do you need to get employer or manager approval first?
questions.description: Understand whether workplace sign-off is required before bringing in or trialling equipment.

questions.title: Will you buy, rent, or borrow the treadmill desk?
questions.description: Clarify how the user plans to source the treadmill desk unit for the trial.

questions.title: How long do you want the trial period to last?
questions.description: Determine the intended duration of the treadmill desk trial.

questions.title: Is this for a private office or a shared open workspace?
questions.description: Understand the physical environment to account for space, noise, and colleague considerations.

questions.title: Do you already have a standing desk to pair it with?
questions.description: Find out whether a compatible standing desk surface is already in place or also needs sourcing.

questions.title: What is your main goal: fitness, focus, or reducing sitting time?
questions.description: Identify the primary motivation so the trial setup and success metrics can be tailored accordingly.

questions.title: Are there any health or safety policies you must comply with?
questions.description: Determine whether workplace health and safety rules or HR policies apply to personal equipment at a workstation.
